description:
TURA is proud to present their brand-new, high-spec apartments to rent, opposite Wellington Place, with panoramic river views, 5-star amenities and exclusive access to The TURA Thread: our professional members' community designed to connect, inspire and elevate your everyday.

Experience the best of city living, renting in the heart of Leeds. With slick surroundings, amazing customer service, incredible amenities and a friendly community feel, with style, comfort and convenience in mind.

In the heart of Leeds, TURA offers riverside living on the River Aire, just steps from Wellington Place, a four-minute walk from Leeds Station and moments away from artisan cafés, boutique shops and the vibrant energy of city life.

The apartment briefly comprises of an open plan modern kitchen, with intergrated appliances including dishwasher and large living room with floor to ceiling windows. There are three equal size bedrooms, one with ensuite bathroom, a second house bathroom and a private balcony that runs the length of the apartment, so ideal for individuals, couples or sharers alike. The apartment belongs within our TURA+ range with the perfect lifestyle touches including curtains, an upgraded kitchen worktop, bedside lamps and wine store. 

The TURA thread: A self-development club designed for our residents, The TURA Thread is your space to grow, connect and explore new opportunities. From inspiring guest speakers to relaxed social gatherings, it's all about building meaningful connections, learning new skills and sparking ideas that could lead to something extraordinary.

New to Leeds? Wellington Place is one of the most sought after areas and is located in the business hub of the city. It hosts many restaurant and bars which are interweaved within landscaped public realms and architecture steeped in history, creating a thriving neighborhood, sense of community and enjoyable as it is productive. The convenience doesn't stop there, with supermarkets, coffee shops and offices all close by, you will love it just as much as we do! 

And don't forget your furry friends! Our apartments are pet friendly so you can both enjoy a City Centre lifestyle!

What's included:

Two outdoor terrace, a 24/7 resident only gym, private dining and entertainment room, an airy atrium lined with workspaces, stylish resident clubhouse, 24/7 reception, regular resident events and several work from home spaces including a boardroom, make up just some of the amazing features that really set this development apart from the rest.
